BERT4Rec uses masked-item prediction; appended-MASK inference must read the MASK position. Proposed independent readout fixture: length-six input `[0,0,0,a,b,MASK]`, whose correct index is 5; counting nonpadding tokens minus one gives 2. Stub the encoder with distinct position-coded features and assert the exact selected vector, independently of production indexing helpers. Also test mixed history lengths and truncation before appending MASK; a full-length-only fixture cannot discriminate these implementations. Check real-model candidate logits against an independently gathered final-MASK feature. [BERT4Rec paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06690)

For padding masking, preserve sequence length, valid token IDs and their absolute positions. Perturb only padded hidden states immediately before attention, retaining the original boolean padding mask; valid outputs and MASK logits should remain unchanged. Moving valid tokens by adding/removing left padding is not a valid invariance with learned absolute positions. PyTorch specifies that `key_padding_mask=True` ignores that key. Supplement this metamorphic check with a deterministic attention fixture: zero query/key projections yield uniform unmasked attention; distinct projected values at padded positions make disabling masking observably change the MASK output. Independently calculate the expected average over valid values. Avoid perturbations erased by embedding zeroing or LayerNorm. [MultiheadAttention documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.modules.activation.MultiheadAttention.html)

Run in evaluation mode without autocast; require finite outputs. Suggested FP32 starting tolerances: `atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5`, calibrated against repeat-run/backend noise; engineer mutant differences comfortably above tolerance. Compare features/logits, since unchanged top-k rankings can conceal defects. Mutate readout and padding masking separately and together. A survivor indicates either a weak fixture or behavioral equivalence; exclude demonstrably equivalent mutants with justification, and report unresolved survivors rather than claiming detection. [PyTorch comparison semantics](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/testing)
